scores.evidence: Pipelines can't run without infrastructure, identity and secrets.
scores.rationale: Phases go discovery → foundations → CI → CD → guardrails → migration with explicit exit criteria and stated dependencies (signed artifacts before CD).

scores.evidence: A "hello world" service can build on platform runners, push to the registry and authenticate to the cloud with no static secrets.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is discovery only; a thin build-push slice appears in Phase 1 but reaches prod only in Phase 3, so no true prod skeleton first.

scores.evidence: Make the core tooling decisions and record each one in an Architecture Decision Record (ADR)
scores.rationale: Irreversible choices are listed up front with some recommended defaults, but flip conditions are missing.

scores.evidence: Wave 1 ~5 Low criticality, common archetype, willing teams
scores.rationale: Waves go low-risk first and foundations precede leaf work, but it is the reverse of widest-impact-first and within-phase ordering is not explicit.

scores.evidence: Use OIDC federation from CI to the cloud. No long-lived credentials in pipelines.
scores.rationale: Security appears in Foundations, CI (SAST/SCA/signing), CD-adjacent policy, enforcement, and SLSA; Phase 0 only via secrets ADR, but it is substantially threaded.

scores.evidence: Phase 4: Observability and Guardrails (Weeks 12–16, overlaps Phase 3)
scores.rationale: Observability is mostly a mid-plan phase; only a DORA baseline exists in Phase 0 and none in Foundations or CI.

scores.evidence: Promote the *same artifact* through every stage; never rebuild per environment.
scores.rationale: IaC environments, immutable tags, reproducible image builds, versioned templates and GitOps config are threaded across phases.

scores.evidence: Rollback: a git revert of the config repo, documented and rehearsed.
scores.rationale: Resilience (rollback, PDBs, parallel runs, canary auto-rollback) appears in CD onward but not in early phases.
The plan never addresses whether an AI layer applies, so N/A is not declared.

scores.evidence: Wave 4 ~5 Legacy and outliers: Custom extensions or a documented exemption
scores.rationale: Later phases and 'remove manual gate later' are deferred, but there are no explicit not-yet-built lists with pull-forward conditions.

note: Solid, well-ordered conventional platform plan, but it has no prod walking skeleton, no flip conditions, observability arrives late, and it never declares the AI layer N/A.
